✨ Magic with Turmeric! 🧪💛❤️

Our little scientists discovered the magic of colour-changing chemistry! 🧑‍🔬👩‍🔬
Watch as the yellow turmeric solution turns red when detergent is added, and then magically changes back to yellow with a squeeze of lemon! 🍋✨

A fun, hands-on way to explore science and learn about acids and bases! 🌈🔬

🌸 Little Hearts, Beautiful Habits! 🌸
At Junior Vidhwaan, we believe that discipline is not about strict rules—it is about helping little minds learn kindness, patience, respect, responsibility, and good manners. 💕✨
Every small habit we build today becomes a beautiful part of who our children grow up to be. 🌱🧸
Teaching them to listen, share, wait for their turn, keep things tidy, and care for others—one little step at a time. 🥰
Because good habits begin with little hearts! 💖🌈

More than just a splash! 💧✨
Our little explorers are having a blast at the water table, but did you know how much learning is happening? Water play is a powerhouse activity that helps build:
Fine Motor Skills: Through pouring, scooping, and squeezing.
Early Science: Discovering concepts like heavy vs. light and sink vs. float.
Social Growth: Sharing tools and laughing together with friends! 💙
Learning through play is always an adventure!
